{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk blend sheath dress, floor-length, charcoal gray (#3a3d40), crepe with a subtle luster.
Point-toe pumps, stiletto heel, classic nude (#e6cbb2), calfskin leather.
Gold drop earrings, polished finish, circular hoops, 18k gold-plated brass.

This ensemble is perfectly suited for an evening theatre visit as it falls within the social formality band required for the occasion. The charcoal sheath dress offers a sophisticated silhouette that respects the refined atmosphere of the performance without being overly restrictive. The nude pumps elongate the legs and maintain a seamless line with the skin tone, while the gold accessories add a touch of necessary glamour against the dark fabric. Together, these pieces create a balanced look that transitions effortlessly from the afternoon arrival to the evening curtain call."}
